# algizian_tenant (Data Source)

Read a tenant, for example to use its issuer in an application's configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algizian_tenant" "myapp" {
  slug = "k3x9q2a"
}

output "issuer" {
  value = coalesce(data.algizian_tenant.myapp.custom_domain_issuer, data.algizian_tenant.myapp.issuer)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `custom_domain_hostname` (String)
- `custom_domain_issuer` (String) The issuer to use once the custom domain is active.
- `custom_domain_status` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issuer` (String) The `<slug>.algizian.com` issuer.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the deletion lock is on.
- `name` (String)
- `org` (String)
- `providers` (Set of String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
